svg.title: Supporting code piled up past the product, after weeks of plans
svg.desc: Stacked lines of supporting Python by group from 15 September to 15 November 2026, with product code as a line. Supporting code passes the product on 2026-10-11, peaks at 269,241 lines on 2026-11-10, three times the product, and is 247,082 lines on 2026-11-15. Below, words written per day; the largest day is 51,556 words on 2026-10-08. Eight numbered turning points are listed under the chart.
svg.text: Words written per day for the developer
one commit adds 1.59 GB of run output
harness pattern; 51,556 words in a day
attended parts, slot and pool land
